Cross-site tracking vocabulary — what translates differently

Safari anti-tracking marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Prevent Cross-Site Tracking in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US developer ITP jargon:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 防止跨网站跟踪 for Prevent Cross-Site Tracking under Settings → Safari → 隐私与安全性, with related buyer language around 跨站跟踪 (cross-site tracking), 跨网站跟踪器 (cross-site trackers), 阻止跨网站跟踪 (block cross-site tracking), and Safari 隐私 (Safari privacy). Listing copy should mirror that consumer Settings vocabulary first — not lead with Intelligent Tracking Prevention unless your English gallery already uses ITP as the buyer-facing label.

Prevent Cross-Site Tracking vs iCloud Private Relay

Private Relay hides IP address and encrypts DNS for Safari browsing — 专用代理, 隐藏 IP 地址. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking limits cross-site tracker behavior during browsing — 防止跨网站跟踪, 跨网站跟踪器. If your English gallery shows the Private Relay toggle, keep zh-Hans copy on hide-IP relay vocabulary, not cross-site tracker claims, unless Prevent Cross-Site Tracking is what the frame depicts.

Prevent Cross-Site Tracking vs App Tracking Transparency

ATT is an in-app IDFA permission sheet — Ask App Not to Track, Allow Tracking — 应用跟踪透明度. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking is a system Safari Settings toggle — 防止跨网站跟踪. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply ATT opt-in improves Safari cross-site tracker blocking unless your English source already makes that precise claim.

Prevent Cross-Site Tracking vs Link Tracking Protection

Link Tracking Protection strips tracking query parameters when users copy or share URLs — 链接跟踪保护. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking limits cross-site trackers during active browsing — 跨站跟踪. Adjacent Safari privacy features with different screenshot vocabulary; do not paste 链接跟踪保护 on dedicated cross-site tracker toggle frames.

Prevent Cross-Site Tracking vs Safari Private Browsing

Private Browsing is a separate incognito window mode — 无痕浏览 — with no browsing history. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking applies to everyday Safari sessions when enabled. Do not keyword-stuff 无痕浏览 when English only showed the cross-site tracking toggle under Safari privacy settings.

AppLocale FAQ

Is Prevent Cross-Site Tracking the same as iCloud Private Relay?

No. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking blocks cross-site trackers during Safari browsing — 防止跨网站跟踪, 跨网站跟踪器. Private Relay hides IP and encrypts DNS for Safari — 专用代理, 隐藏 IP 地址. See our Private Relay listing guide only when hide-IP relay is your lead marketing claim.

Is Prevent Cross-Site Tracking the same as App Tracking Transparency?

No. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking is a system Safari Settings toggle. ATT is an in-app IDFA permission prompt. See our App Tracking Transparency listing guide when Ask App Not to Track is your lead claim.

Is Prevent Cross-Site Tracking the same as Safari Private Browsing?

No. Private Browsing is incognito window mode — 无痕浏览. Prevent Cross-Site Tracking limits cross-site trackers in everyday Safari sessions. See our Safari Private Browsing listing guide when private tabs are your lead claim.

Only if your English source already leads with ITP as the buyer-facing label. AppLocale prioritizes consumer Settings vocabulary — Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, Cross-Site Tracking, 防止跨网站跟踪 — and treats ITP as supporting engine context. AppLocale does not publish a separate itp twin slug page.
